name: Tofu, Bell Pepper & Tomato Gumbo with Green Onion Rice
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; place half in a medium bowl. (Set remaining green onions aside for the rice.)
Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add both to the bowl with the green onion.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, stirring often, until mixture is golden brown, 2-3 minutes.
When the flour mixture is golden brown, add veggies to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the veggies are soft, add broth and spices to the skillet; bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Add tofu and tomatoes to the skillet; stir to combine the gumbo. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Just before serving, add remaining green onion to the rice, and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide green onion rice and gumbo between bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
